title: Government of India Public Provident Fund (PPF) Scheme Rules 2019/2026
source: Ministry of Finance, Government of India / National Savings Institute
content: The Public Provident Fund (PPF) is governed under Government of India Small Savings Scheme Rules. Key provisions: Minimum annual deposit is ₹500, maximum is ₹1,50,000 per financial year. Account tenure is 15 financial years, extendable in blocks of 5 years with or without further contributions. Interest rate is notified quarterly by the Ministry of Finance. PPF enjoys EEE tax status: principal contribution qualifies under Section 80C, interest earned is tax-free, and maturity withdrawal is fully exempt.
